Actually w1 not tested. D weighted pool4 inverse_error. E trimmed_mean pool4. F weighted pool4 softmax. G median pool4. H dba pool4.

Pick one different kind. Maybe median pool4 (G) is robust. Let's test that.

attempts.rationale: The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings, so a robust weighted combo should help.
test a robust trimmed_mean combination to see if trimming reduces influence of high-error models in this trend-dominated, unstable ranking series.
Test a simple robust median combination, which may handle unstable rankings and correlated errors.
Test a deterministic weighted averaging (dba) which may better handle unstable rankings in a trend‑dominated series.
test a simple non‑robust mean combination to see if a plain average beats the trimmed mean in this trend‑dominated, unstable ranking series.
test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if a probabilistic weighting improves over trimmed mean in this trend‑dominated, unstable ranking series.
The series has unstable rankings and strong trend; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture changing model strengths across horizons.
test a robust weighted combo on the top‑7 pool using softmax_neg_error to see if a non‑uniform weight improves over trimmed mean.
test a weighted combination on the reduced, robust pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a non‑robust weight scheme improves over the current trimmed mean leader.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting on the correlated pool4 may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination on pool4 using the top‑k‑mean-per‑horizon handle (w7) to exploit horizon‑specific strengths in a trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust median on a reduced, diverse pool (pool4) may improve over trimmed mean.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9741. Series context: trend strength 0.9306 and seasonal strength 0.1891; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.228); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.415.
